nodes.label: Authoritative Server Session Timing
nodes.rationale: Server timestamps are authoritative; clients only interpolate countdowns between refreshes to avoid client clock tampering or desync.

nodes.label: Device Enrollment and Heartbeat Protocol
nodes.rationale: Public first-run enrollment generates token hash on server and stores token securely on client; heartbeats every 15s mark PCs offline after 45s.

nodes.label: Local-First Architecture Principle
nodes.rationale: Local operations must remain usable without internet; live session timing or billing cannot depend on cloud availability.

nodes.label: Modular Monolith Backend
nodes.rationale: Modular monolith backend shares one PostgreSQL database while keeping domain boundaries clean without microservice complexity for local single-machine deployment.

nodes.label: One Session Per PC Invariant
nodes.rationale: Enforced via partial unique index on open sessions (ACTIVE/PAUSED) and row-level locks to protect against concurrent race conditions.

nodes.label: Outbox Cloud Sync Pattern
nodes.rationale: Durable sync events recorded in local transaction outbox; sync worker delivers only when internet is available to keep local operations fully decoupled from cloud.

nodes.label: Rate Snapshotting Principle
nodes.rationale: Session snapshots hourly rate at creation so subsequent pricing plan rate changes cannot retroactively alter billing history.

nodes.label: Atomic State Persistence Mechanism
nodes.rationale: Writes to temporary file, flushes to disk, and replaces atomically to prevent corrupting machine identity or PC ID after an unexpected crash.

nodes.label: Agent Credential Storage Hierarchy
nodes.rationale: Tries Windows Credential Manager via keyring, falls back to DPAPI, and only falls back to plaintext if explicitly enabled for development environments.

nodes.label: Local-First Gaming Cafe Management
nodes.rationale: Initial deployment runs on the owner's Windows computer hosting application and database locally; live operations must function without internet.
